description: Fork of exp755 (E=192 dv=32 + exp754 recipe with hybrid_smooth + dense_K). Single change: forward_mode hybrid_smooth -> hard. Tests narrow-E (E=192, dv=32) with the HARD-mode equivalent of today's recipe (= exp752 recipe shrunk to E=192). Expected ~176 M params. Hybrid_smooth → hard delta should follow the +65-70 mb gap pattern we saw with exp754. Native-hard training avoids that gap but typically gives a slightly worse soft eval. Compare: exp752 (E=384 hard) = 1.2162; exp755 (E=192 hybrid_smooth) projected ~1.20-1.21. exp756 (E=192 hard) is the deployment-quality counterpart.
